_comment: Allow list for `bigquery-data-science check-pinned-models` (also run by `bigquery-data-science sweep`). Keys are repo-relative project paths; `*` applies to every project, and `deprecated` maps retired model/endpoint literals to their recommended replacements for `review-sql`. A model or endpoint literal pinned anywhere in a project (notebook code cells, .sql, fenced code in markdown, .py) that is not listed in `*` or the project key fails the check.
